title: centaurea phrygia subsp. nigriceps
intro: Centaurea phrygia subsp. nigriceps, commonly known as a type of knapweed, is a plant species within the daisy family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The health benefits of Centaurea phrygia subsp. nigriceps are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of these bioactive compounds on human health.
